js: (() => { const W = window.__game, d = W.debug; d.unlockAll(); W.points = 1e6; document.querySelectorAll('.coach button').forEach(b => /דלג/.test(b.textContent) && b.click()); const ids = W.biome.species.map(s => s.id); let placed = 0; for (let rep = 0; rep < 2; rep++) for (const id of ids) for (let i = 0; i < 15; i++) { const a = Math.random() * 6.28, r = 6 + Math.random() * 30; if (typeof d.place(id, Math.cos(a) * r, Math.sin(a) * r) === 'object') { placed++; break; } } for (let k = 0; k < 8; k++) { d.auto(); d.ff(10); } return 'placed ' + placed + ' plants ' + W.plants.length + ' animals ' + W.animals.length; })()

(()=>{const p=window.__app.pipe,r=p.renderer; r.info.autoReset=false; r.info.reset(); p.render(); const c=r.info.render.calls; r.info.reset(); r.info.autoReset=true; const W=window.__game; let t0=performance.now(); for(let i=0;i<20;i++) W.debug.ff(0.1); const upd=((performance.now()-t0)/20).toFixed(2); const L=W.debug.light; return 'grove calls '+c+' tris '+r.info.render.triangles+' plants '+W.plants.length+' animals '+W.animals.length+' updMs '+upd})()
